messages:
Maria (PM): Quick thread to align scope for an incremental observability launch: dashboards + tiny tracing hooks + cost rollups. Need acceptance criteria.
Jake (Eng): We can do minimal span metadata (request_id, model, route, token_counts) with negligible payload if encoded compactly.
Sam (SRE): Must include sampling policy upfront. Suggest: errors=100% sampled, success=0.1% default, adjustable per-tenant. Also budget cap per-host.
Anya (Data): Rollups hourly keyed by tenant|route|model. We'll compute normalized USD in rollup. Need deterministic seed for sampling to pick reproducible exemplars.
Lukas (Design): Dashboard: top-level toggle for "estimated cost" vs "raw usage" and a single-row drilldown that surfaces p95 latency + example error trace link. Keep UI minimal for alpha.
Maria (PM): Draft acceptance checklist: 1) Dashboard shows 30/7/90d cost by route+model, 2) Sampled traces contain request_id+model metadata, 3) Docs on sampling and cost assumptions, 4) Latency impact <2% p95, 5) Configurable ingest cap.
Jake (Eng): Action: 2-day spike to measure span serialize cost and a small feature flag to enable header.
Sam (SRE): I'll run a staging canary at 0.1% and report CPU/ingest delta.
Anya (Data): I'll produce rollup schema + example billing export CSV with optional trace_link.
Maria (PM): Plan: spike + canary + rollup proto. If metrics look good, alpha to 3 enterprise customers behind flag. Sync Friday 9am. Thanks! :thumbsup:
